records.scope: Entire javap display including all methods and initializers; static reading only.
records.observation: All three size fields static, initially0. Setter stores world size W and thread count T, computes WT using int multiplication. Global thread ID=comm*(W*T)+rank*T+thread; process ID=comm*W+rank, all signed int arithmetic without overflow, sign, range or initialization guards. Before setter, thread ID reduces to thread and process ID to rank; global settings shared across decoders, so later reconfiguration changes future IDs. Constructor only Object init. Caller preamble validation/initialization remains separate unread obligation; does not establish actual collision-free inputs.

records.observation: Constructor copies communicator index, local rank, world rank and unboxed event type from RecComm; stores supplied thread and computes gthdLineID through shared LineID configuration. Used flag initially false; mutable public fields and used setter/getter, no validation/recompute after public field mutation. toString includes delegated communicator type string. Original RecComm reuse does not change these copied scalar fields.

records.observation: TreeMap uses Coord.LINEID_ORDER, so timestamp0 keys compare by lineID alone (previous Coord comparator uses int subtraction). addComm iterates thread0..<max_thread_count, creates scalar ID entry and Coord0/key, inserts only if absent: duplicate ID retains first metadata/used state, no communicator deletion/update handling based on etype. Nonpositive thread count inserts none. initialize no-op. setCommProcThdIDUsed looks up start vertex, logs if absent but unconditionally calls setUsed on null, causing NPE; arrow topology additionally does same for final vertex. Only start IDs marked for non-arrow primitives. This call occurs outside ContentIterator reflective invocation catch ranges, so missing-map failure escapes that handling. finish destructively removes unused entries, with no completion flag. createYCoordMapList always builds two maps in TreeMap value order, does not itself filter used entries (caller invokes finish). If max_thread_count>1, Process-Thread rows=[gthdLineID,wrank,thd], Communicator-Thread rows=[gthdLineID,icomm,rank,thd]; otherwise Process rows=[gthdLineID,wrank], Communicator rows=[gthdLineID,icomm,rank]. Titles/column names match these fields, method IDs null, row count=size including0. Distinct communicator IDs can map to same world-rank/thread displayed location; no grouping/dedup by view coordinates. Array products int unchecked. Public inherited map mutations and mutable Coord keys not constrained.
